name: Svetlik Analytics for Contact Form 7
author: Jaroslav Svetlik

sections.description:
Svetlik Analytics provides a simple dashboard that shows submission trends and statistics for Contact Form 7 forms over time.

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Contact Form 7 team.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Contact → Analytics
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Refactored all plugin functions, classes, hooks, nonces, and asset handles to use a unique svetlik_cf7a prefix to avoid conflicts.
  • Renamed plugin constants and the events table to a unique prefix, and added automatic DB schema upgrade + legacy table migration.
  • Fixed license declaration mismatch by aligning the LICENSE file with “GPLv2 or later”.

1.0.2

  • Plugin name and metadata updates.

1.0.1

  • Minor changes.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
